method: Read-only PostgreSQL catalog allocation; no exact row counts or guaranteed cleanup savings

tables.name: amazon_fba_inventory_snapshots
tables.purpose: Time-stamped Amazon FBA quantities, inventory states and original API payloads.

tables.name: sourcing_opportunities
tables.purpose: Scored eBay/Amazon pairs, profitability, routing state and full matching diagnostics.

tables.name: keepa_product_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time read-only Keepa product snapshots for catalog intelligence, price history, sales-rank history, and sales-frequency signals.

tables.name: sourcing_listing_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time evidence snapshots for sourced eBay listings that became MBOP opportunities or received operator/system actions.

tables.name: sourcing_ebay_candidates
tables.purpose: Discovered eBay listings, prices, availability, shipping and original listing payload.

tables.name: sourcing_coverage_cycle_items
tables.purpose: Durable per-ASIN sourcing queue and progress state for the unified daily coverage cycle.

tables.name: amazon_listing_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time read-only Amazon Listings Items snapshots for listing status, issues, and fulfillment availability.

tables.name: informed_listing_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time read-only Informed Repricer listing/pricing report rows used by MBOP repricing advisor.

tables.name: inventory_reconciliation_event_items
tables.purpose: Item-level reconciliation findings. Used to answer what MBOP believes is owned, what Amazon/eBay believe exists, what is in transition, and what needs operator review.

tables.name: amazon_inventory_planning_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time read-only Amazon FBA Inventory Planning report rows. Used for Amazon-native aged-inventory buckets in the repricing advisor.

tables.name: sourcing_seed_asins
tables.purpose: Run-specific Amazon product seeds, demand/inventory context and queue provenance.

tables.name: inventory_positions
tables.purpose: Derived current inventory positions for MBOP. Workflow tables remain authoritative; this layer normalizes location, marketplace intent, listing channel, operational state, and disposition for reconciliation.

tables.name: sourcing_decision_refresh_log
tables.purpose: Atomic decision-refresh audit and idempotency records; before/after guarded state.

tables.name: matching_intelligence_examples
tables.purpose: Rebuildable labeled examples for matching diagnostics and future scoring. Business-only labels must not poison ASIN identity matching.

tables.name: scheduler_run_jobs
tables.purpose: Per-job execution telemetry, logs/metadata, errors and result counts.

tables.name: amazon_sales_financial_events
tables.purpose: Amazon sales charges, fees and financial event evidence.

tables.name: order_problem_events
tables.purpose: Append-only order-problem workflow actions, messages and audit history.

tables.name: amazon_finance_balance_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time read-only Amazon Finance balance snapshots for Amazon-held cash, available withdrawal cash, and Amazon-to-bank in-transit cash.

tables.name: amazon_sales_finance_transactions
tables.purpose: Amazon finance transaction records used by sales reconciliation.

tables.name: sourcing_actions
tables.purpose: Operator review, dismissal, watch, offer, purchase and hold history.

tables.name: purchases
tables.purpose: Supplier/eBay order headers and source order evidence.

tables.name: amazon_sales_orders
tables.purpose: Amazon seller order headers imported from SP-API Orders. This table must not store buyer name, address, email, or phone.

tables.name: source_records
tables.purpose: Row- or document-level provenance for imported and manually confirmed records.

tables.name: course_sections
tables.purpose: Registration sections for a term offering; section restrictions are MVP columns/JSONB until detailed filtering requires a child table.

tables.name: scheduler_runs
tables.purpose: Scheduler invocation status, timing, task identity and errors.

tables.name: purchase_items
tables.purpose: Purchased units, ASIN, authoritative cost, manual corrections and workflow status.

tables.name: ynab_business_transactions
tables.purpose: Read-only local copy of YNAB transactions categorized as Business for future P&L, Schedule C, and cash reconciliation reporting.

tables.name: sourcing_runs
tables.purpose: Sourcing execution summaries, settings, quotas, counts and errors.

tables.name: veeqo_sales_orders
tables.purpose: Veeqo seller-order and label-cost source records.

tables.name: inbound_shipments
tables.purpose: Inbound tracking, carrier enrichment and delivery evidence.

tables.name: amazon_sales_profitability
tables.purpose: Backend sales profitability and COGS/fee outcomes.

tables.name: sourcing_seller_intelligence
tables.purpose: Derived seller intelligence for sourcing diagnostics. Avoid status is advisory only until hide-by-default is explicitly enabled.

tables.name: sourcing_opportunity_batch_items
tables.purpose: Stable membership of scored sourcing opportunities presented in each progressive batch.

tables.name: amazon_sales_cogs_consumption
tables.purpose: Sales allocation/consumption against inventory cost layers.

tables.name: fba_shipment_items
tables.purpose: Purchase-item quantities allocated to Amazon outbound shipments.

tables.name: non_ebay_purchase_cogs_sources
tables.purpose: Non-eBay inventory cost evidence and import provenance.

tables.name: inbound_shipment_items
tables.purpose: Purchase-unit allocation and receipt resolution per inbound package.

tables.name: courses
tables.purpose: Catalog courses; not semester offerings or registration sections.

tables.name: veeqo_sales_shipments
tables.purpose: Veeqo shipment, tracking and label-cost evidence.

tables.name: amazon_fee_estimates
tables.purpose: Cached SP-API Product Fees v0 estimates used for pre-FBA shipment pricing and ROI review.

tables.name: matching_intelligence_receiving_outcomes
tables.purpose: Receiving-owned item verification outcomes consumed by Matching Intelligence as explicit labeled evidence.

tables.name: order_problem_cases
tables.purpose: Order exceptions, returns/refunds/replacements and operator workflow state.

tables.name: amazon_fba_customer_return_rows
tables.purpose: Raw and normalized rows from GET_FBA_FULFILLMENT_CUSTOMER_RETURNS_DATA. Return reason, disposition, status, LPN, and customer comments are preserved for Amazon Return Recovery evidence.

tables.name: amazon_report_runs
tables.purpose: Audit table for read-only Amazon SP-API report requests and imports. No Amazon seller order/customer data should be requested for MBOP inventory workflows.

tables.name: sourcing_blocked_asins
tables.purpose: Operator/restriction product blocks; preserved business protection.

tables.name: inventorylab_active_inventory_backfill
tables.purpose: Historical InventoryLab active inventory backfill data. Stores legacy cost/date context separately from MBOP purchase_items.

tables.name: fba_shipments
tables.purpose: Amazon outbound shipment headers, progress and value.

tables.name: import_batches
tables.purpose: Source import provenance and processing summaries.

tables.name: sourcing_purchase_matches
tables.purpose: Links sourcing decisions/listings to imported buyer purchases.

tables.name: inventorylab_inventory_valuation_snapshots
tables.purpose: InventoryLab valuation export snapshots used as a legacy opening-balance valuation layer for current Amazon FBA inventory. This table does not update purchase_items.

tables.name: ynab_category_balance_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time read-only YNAB category balance snapshots. MBOP uses the Business category available balance as cash on hand.

tables.name: amazon_return_recovery_cases
tables.purpose: Amazon-side workflow cases for FBA customer returns and removals returned to the business. This table must not write to purchases, purchase_items, receiving, Order Problems, or FBA shipment prep workflow rows.

tables.name: amazon_catalog_item_identity_snapshots
tables.purpose: Cached read-only Amazon Catalog Items identity evidence for sourcing diagnostics. Exact-ASIN structured evidence is preferred over title inference.

tables.name: informed_report_runs
tables.purpose: Audit table for read-only Informed Repricer Reports API requests and imports. Signed download links are intentionally not persisted.

tables.name: amazon_fba_removal_shipment_detail_rows
tables.purpose: Amazon FBA removal shipment report evidence.

tables.name: business_value_snapshots
tables.purpose: Daily backend-computed MBOP business value snapshots for trend reporting. Values are derived from existing inventory, Amazon Finance, and YNAB snapshot sources.

tables.name: amazon_inventory_cogs_layers
tables.purpose: Inventory cost layers consumed by sales COGS.

tables.name: inventory_reconciliation_events
tables.purpose: Run-level reconciliation records comparing MBOP projected inventory positions to external inventory sources such as Amazon FBA snapshots.

tables.name: sourcing_opportunity_batches
tables.purpose: Durable sourcing opportunity batches used by the progressive Find 100 More workflow.

tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Auth: Stores user login data within a secure schema.

tables.name: inventory_movements
tables.purpose: Append-only audit trail for inventory state/location/marketplace transitions. Existing workflow tables still own their own transitions; this table records normalized inventory movement projections.

tables.name: sourcing_coverage_cycles
tables.purpose: Durable daily sourcing coverage-cycle header. One active cycle represents one pass through eligible ASINs.

tables.name: sourcing_sales_velocity_suppressions
tables.purpose: Dynamic ASIN-level suppression for valid products dismissed because sales velocity is too low. Suppression releases only when the current sourcing velocity threshold is met.

tables.name: amazon_repricing_advisor_snoozes
tables.purpose: Operator snooze state for Aged Amazon Inventory recommendations. A snoozed SKU remains hidden from the default advisor list until snoozed_until.

tables.name: manual_item_matches
tables.purpose: Operator-corrected title/platform to ASIN match memory.

tables.name: scheduler_job_definitions
tables.purpose: Scheduler job definitions, cadence and freshness expectations.

tables.name: amazon_sales_fulfillment_cost_overrides
tables.purpose: Operator fulfillment-cost overrides used in profitability.

tables.name: student_profiles
tables.purpose: Private student planning profile owned by an application user.

tables.name: application_users
tables.purpose: Future Cognito-linked users for College Planner access control.

tables.name: informed_rule_name_overrides
tables.purpose: Manual display-name mapping for Informed Repricer strategy/rule IDs when report exports only provide numeric IDs.

tables.name: refresh_tokens
tables.purpose: Auth: Store of tokens used to refresh JWT tokens once they expire.

tables.name: degree_requirement_groups
tables.purpose: Flexible requirement areas for program, core, elective, recurring, and residency rules.

tables.name: sourcing_declined_ebay_offers
tables.purpose: Highest observed buyer-declined USD item offer per eBay listing. Absence from later API responses never clears evidence. Not a complete offer history.

tables.name: student_academic_records
tables.purpose: Private student coursework history, registrations, transfer credit, test credit, and planned placeholders if needed.

tables.name: sessions
tables.purpose: Auth: Stores session data associated to a user.

tables.name: saml_relay_states
tables.purpose: Auth: Contains SAML Relay State information for each Service Provider initiated login.

tables.name: informed_rule_snapshots
tables.purpose: Point-in-time read-only Informed Repricer rule/settings report rows, populated only if a rule definition report is available.
